statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is constructed from two line items in the operating activities section of the cash flow statement: 'Depreciation and impairment of Equipment on operating leases, net' and 'Depreciation, amortization and impairment charges on Property, net'. These are the only non-cash add-backs to net income that directly correspond to depreciation and amortization. Other non-cash items (e.g., deferred taxes, pension income) are not included as they are not depreciation or amortization expenses. The scale is 1E6 (millions) as indicated in the statement header. The supplementary tables provided detail components of operating asset/liability changes and cash paid for taxes/interest, but do not contain additional elements for the depreciation_and_amortization field.
